name: Local Sparse Volume Reconstruction
definition: A deep neural network that regresses a local neural volume $V_t$ for each input frame t, using its image $I_t$ and $K-1$ neighboring images. It builds volumes in canonical world coordinate frame to align with the global volume.
summary: Local Sparse Volume Reconstruction regresses local neural volumes in canonical space by aggregating multi-view features, enabling global fusion unlike MVS-NeRF.
